mode_inference_decision.rationale: Original three-view modeling reference only; no reference-sheet pixels enter runtime. Solid magenta permits deterministic subject isolation if a view is accepted.

invariants: Weathered steel plate gauntlet with warm brass edge and brown leather palm
Right hand, four fingers and one thumb
Credible fully closed sword power grip
Consistent same-hand pose and scale in all views
qa_gates: Thumb opposes fingers rather than duplicating a finger
Four separate finger rhythms around handle
No extra digits or disembodied fragments
Plate overlaps permit knuckle bending and retain brown palm flexibility
No impossible steel fold or visible hand/handle penetration
All views agree on thumb side and wrist angle
source_review: PARTIAL: middle view supports manual grip/contact reference; left supports dorsal armor design; right supports thumb-side silhouette. Different wrist elevations prevent registered multi-view use.
limitations: Illustrated handle diameter is a design hint, not a measurement or fit proof
A later original mesh must be verified against the actual sword grip geometry
